en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Just like always...
we're surrounded by problems.

<CLT=cltMIND>This academy is full of mysteries,
and I'm worried about Kokichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>And then there's the...thing
with me and Kaito...

I need to make up with him...
For us...and for Maki.
<CLT=cltMIND>I fell asleep thinking about it...
*cough, cough*
*cough, cough*...*cough, cough*!
D-Damn...it...
Wh-Why...? Why...now?
Why...me?
Damn it... I'm running...outta time.

I can't die like this...
Like hell am I gonna...die here...
I...I still...haven't gone...t-to space...
Damn it...
Recklessness is a beautiful thing.

It's so beautiful, I want to print the words
"Reckless Beauty" on a t-shirt.

Because recklessness is the stuff that
dreams are made of.

It's what makes you run at full speed, with
no regard for your limitations.
It's what makes you excited by anything.

Some say it's foolish, but recklessness is
what causes new events to unfold.

So while you're still alive, live your life so
recklessly that it makes you immortal.

And if haters laugh at you, let them. They just
don't appreciate reckless beauty like you do.

Ahem! This is an announcement from the
Ultimate Academy!

Rise and shine, kiddos! It's another
gorgeous day for a killing game!

So get out there, embrace your homicidal
urges, and have a fabulous day!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure everyone is gathered
in the dining hall. I should go too.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>How many more nights do I have to
sleep in this bed? I'm so...sick of it!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
